_what_this_is: A MEASUREMENT SNAPSHOT of delegation capacity, not a ranking. Lanes appear and vanish without notice -- Qwen and DashScope both died between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-14, and OpenRouter silently retired four :free tiers in the same window. Nothing here is 'primary'. Routing is a selection function over the measured properties below, applied fresh each time. See docs/rules/DELEGATION.md section 'Choosing a lane'.
_expires: Treat as stale after 7 days or after any 401/404 from a lane. Re-probe, do not assume.
_probe_task: unified-diff codegen from a natural-language spec, max_tokens>=1000, temperature 0

selection_properties.tier: What the task needs: micro (mechanical, <1 file) | scoped (a real diff) | reasoning (design/diagnosis) | long-context (many files at once) | shell (must run commands) | verdict (go/no-go, human-consequential)
selection_properties.cost_class: free = no meter running | free-quota = capped pool, spend deliberately | metered = real money or Anthropic quota | expensive = native session
selection_properties.latency_s: Measured, not advertised. Dominates for micro work dispatched in bulk.
selection_properties.context: Hard ceiling on how much source you can hand it in one shot.
selection_properties.quota: Requests and tokens per day. A fast lane with 2400 req/day beats a faster one with 100.
selection_properties.quirks: Per-lane traps that make output silently useless. Read before first use.

traps: EMPTY CONTENT IS THE DEFAULT FAILURE MODE OF FREE REASONING MODELS. They spend the whole max_tokens budget on hidden reasoning and return content=''. On OpenRouter send reasoning:{effort:low}; for nemotron-ultra via OpenRouter send reasoning:{exclude:true}. An empty response is not a refusal and not a defect -- retry with the knob before declaring the lane dead.
NEVER send a `reasoning` field to Google, NVIDIA NIM, Cerebras or Groq -- they reject or ignore it. It is an OpenRouter-only parameter.
The same model can differ 4x in latency by route: nemotron-3-ultra-550b is 12.5s on NIM direct and 48.2s via OpenRouter. Prefer the provider's own endpoint when both exist.
Cerebras enforces 5 req/min as roughly 1 req/sec. Serialise bulk dispatch.
One task file -> one provider. Parallel dispatch of the same task file collides on the output path and one result is silently lost.
Never read $? after a pipe -- the pipeline status is the last command's, so a piped gate can never fail.
